claim_continuity.manuscript_claim_boundary: The manuscript may report descriptive within-occupation wage gaps across generation industries; it must not claim that working in renewable generation causes lower or higher pay, and establishment mechanisms are interpretation, not measured pathways.

mechanism_result_matrix.mechanism: Legacy rent-sharing and institutional wage-setting raise pay in fossil and nuclear plants.
mechanism_result_matrix.model_or_spec: M3 headline renewable coefficient with occupation x year fixed effects.
mechanism_result_matrix.expected_pattern: Negative renewable coefficient that remains after occupation controls.
mechanism_result_matrix.manuscript_implication: Interpret a negative gap as consistent with establishment wage premia, not as proof of rent-sharing.

mechanism_result_matrix.mechanism: Source-specific institutional maturity (hydro legacy-like, nuclear highest).
mechanism_result_matrix.model_or_spec: M4 source indicators relative to fossil fuel.
mechanism_result_matrix.expected_pattern: Nuclear positive, hydro near zero, solar and wind negative.
mechanism_result_matrix.manuscript_implication: Show that the renewable divide is not a single green-versus-brown contrast.

mechanism_result_matrix.mechanism: Establishment premia matter most for plant-based occupations.
mechanism_result_matrix.model_or_spec: M5 renewable x occupational group interactions with joint Wald test.
mechanism_result_matrix.expected_pattern: Larger negative gaps for installation/maintenance/repair and production occupations.
mechanism_result_matrix.manuscript_implication: Discuss which workers bear the largest pay differences in a fossil-to-renewable shift.

mechanism_result_matrix.mechanism: Maturation and labor standards (IRA) narrow the gap.
mechanism_result_matrix.model_or_spec: M6 renewable x year and linear trend.
mechanism_result_matrix.manuscript_implication: If not observed, state that the gap persisted through the IRA period within the limits of pooled OEWS data.

robustness_claim_matrix.robustness_check: Unweighted estimates with equal cell weights
robustness_claim_matrix.claim_implication: Strengthens H1 if the gap does not depend on employment weighting.
robustness_claim_matrix.weaken_or_bound_rule: If the sign reverses, describe the headline as driven by large cells.

robustness_claim_matrix.robustness_check: Inverse sampling-variance weights based on reported mean-wage relative standard errors
robustness_claim_matrix.claim_implication: Strengthens H1 by down-weighting noisy cells.
robustness_claim_matrix.weaken_or_bound_rule: If estimates shrink materially, report precision-weighted gap as a bound.

robustness_claim_matrix.claim_implication: Shows the gap is not driven by skewed upper tails.
robustness_claim_matrix.weaken_or_bound_rule: If the median gap differs, discuss where in the distribution the gap sits.

robustness_claim_matrix.robustness_check: Restrict to occupations observed in both renewable and non-renewable industries in every year (balanced set)
robustness_claim_matrix.claim_implication: Strengthens H5 by holding occupation coverage fixed.
robustness_claim_matrix.weaken_or_bound_rule: If trends differ, attribute raw trend to changing coverage.

robustness_claim_matrix.robustness_check: Alternative categorization: nuclear excluded (renewable vs fossil only)
robustness_claim_matrix.claim_implication: Shows whether the renewable gap is a nuclear premium.
robustness_claim_matrix.weaken_or_bound_rule: If the gap vanishes, reframe headline as a nuclear premium.

robustness_claim_matrix.robustness_check: Alternative categorization: hydroelectric excluded from renewable group
robustness_claim_matrix.claim_implication: Shows whether hydro dilutes the renewable gap.
robustness_claim_matrix.weaken_or_bound_rule: If the gap grows, emphasise solar/wind as the low-paying segment.

robustness_claim_matrix.claim_implication: Checks sensitivity to the ambiguous other category.
robustness_claim_matrix.weaken_or_bound_rule: If results change, keep other excluded and report.
If estimates change, report as sensitive to small cells.

robustness_claim_matrix.claim_implication: Shows no single renewable source drives H1.
robustness_claim_matrix.weaken_or_bound_rule: If one source drives it, state source-specific claims only.

limitation_scope_matrix.limitation: No worker-level controls; within-occupation gaps can reflect sorting on unmeasured skill.
limitation_scope_matrix.affected_claim: Gaps cannot be read as the pay change a given worker would experience.
limitation_scope_matrix.scope_language: Describe gaps as differences in average pay for the same occupation across industries.

limitation_scope_matrix.limitation: National cells do not adjust for regional cost of living or plant location.
limitation_scope_matrix.affected_claim: Part of gaps may reflect geography.
limitation_scope_matrix.scope_language: State regional composition as an untested alternative explanation.

limitation_scope_matrix.limitation: OEWS pools six panels over three years; adjacent releases overlap.
limitation_scope_matrix.scope_language: Describe trends as gradual, smoothed changes; avoid attributing shifts to single policy dates.

limitation_scope_matrix.limitation: Petroleum generation is not separable from fossil fuel; transmission and distribution not covered.
limitation_scope_matrix.affected_claim: Results do not speak to petroleum separately or to grid occupations.
limitation_scope_matrix.scope_language: Define scope as six-digit generation industries.
